For push-based sources, data is sent or pushed to the ingestion pipeline from another service,
such as Amazon Security Lake or Amazon DynamoDB. In this scenario, the ingestion role needs, at
minimum, the osis:Ingest permission to interact with the pipeline.
The following IAM access policy demonstrates how to grant this permission to the ingestion role:
JSON
{
"Version":"2012-10-17",
"Statement": [
{
"Effect": "Allow",
"Action": [
"osis:Ingest"
],
"Resource": "arn:aws:osis:us-east-1:111122223333:pipeline/pipeline-name/*"
}
]
}
Ingestion role
33
